title: Add-to-meal-plan service: existing plan mutations
description: Create the service methods that load an existing meal plan, build the recipe reference, append into an existing block or append a new block and add into its first section, then serialise and write back once per action.
acceptance_criteria: `AddToMealPlanService` can add the current recipe to an existing block's first section using the typed mutation APIs.
`AddToMealPlanService` can add a new block to an existing plan and immediately place the recipe into section 0 of that block.
The service follows the standard read → parse → mutate → serialise → write discipline and does not edit text directly in the view layer.

handoff_summary.completed: Both service methods implemented: `addToBlock(recipeURL:recipesFolder:to:blockIndex:)` and `addNewBlock(recipeURL:recipesFolder:to:blockHeading:)`. `MutationError` covers read failure, path resolution failure, and write failure. Build passes cleanly from the worktree-generated project.
handoff_summary.remaining: No remaining work for this bead. Downstream bead for new-plan creation (B-efeedcc5) should implement `AddToMealPlanService.create(...)` following the same pattern. UI wiring (sheet, bottom bar button) is out of scope for this bead.
handoff_summary.risks: The `project.yml` uses directory-level source discovery, so no manual project file changes are needed — XcodeGen auto-includes new Swift files. The main-branch `.xcodeproj` is gitignored and was restored after build verification; the worktree's generated `.xcodeproj` is also gitignored.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should write unit tests for both `addToBlock` and `addNewBlock` covering: successful append to existing block section 0, successful new-block creation with recipe in section 0, read failure (returns `MutationError.readFailed`), and path resolution failure (URL outside recipesFolder).
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflict risk with sibling beads. `AddToMealPlanService.swift` is a new file not touched by any other in-progress bead. The upstream `MealPlanRecipePath.swift` (B-e032faca) and mutation APIs (B-c6573e45) are already committed on the feature branch.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Named the error type `MutationError` (not `AppendError`) because both methods mutate rather than purely append. Chose `section: 0` as the hard-coded section index for `addItem` to match the acceptance criteria requirement of placing into section 0 — callers don't currently need per-section control. `quantity` is left `nil` on the constructed `MealPlanRecipe`; the quantity bead (part of B-efeedcc5 new-plan scope) is responsible for wiring up servings-based quantity.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Test cases needed: (1) `addToBlock` with a valid plan that has at least one block — verify recipe appended to section 0; (2) `addNewBlock` on any plan — verify block count +1 and recipe in new block's section 0; (3) read failure path by passing a non-existent planURL; (4) path resolution failure by passing a recipeURL outside recipesFolder.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The service currently does not validate that `blockIndex` is within bounds before calling `addItem` — `MealPlan.addItem` is a no-op on out-of-bounds indices, so a silent failure is possible if the caller passes a stale index. A bounds check or error case could be added by a follow-up bead if the UI surface makes it necessary.

conflict_risks: No conflict risk with sibling beads. `AddToMealPlanService.swift` is a new file not touched by any other in-progress bead. The upstream `MealPlanRecipePath.swift` (B-e032faca) and mutation APIs (B-c6573e45) are already committed on the feature branch.

execution_history.summary: Created `AddToMealPlanService.swift` with two service methods for existing-plan mutations: `addToBlock` (appends recipe to section 0 of an existing block) and `addNewBlock` (creates a new block with the given heading and places the recipe into its section 0). Both methods follow the read→parse→mutate→serialize→write discipline using `MealPlanFiles`, `MealPlanParser`, `MealPlanRecipePath`, and the typed `MealPlan` mutation APIs from CookbookCore. Build verified via `xcodegen` + `xcodebuild` from the worktree with no errors.
